opening.argument: The speaker recruits viewers into a distributor team, linking participation to making money and mining coins, and urges them to obtain S-Coin while claiming its value will be higher soon. The opportunity is presented with a guarantee of success before viewers begin. This combination of team recruitment, expected appreciation, and assured success promotes a tiered, network-based earning opportunity, not merely a product or service. The speaker also directs viewers to a link for more information about the earnings and cash-out process, while presenting wallet transactions and a cash-out demonstration as proof of legitimacy. Those demonstrations do not change the central pitch: join the business, participate in its network, and expect financial success. The video therefore advances recruitment commissions and tiered-matrix claims, even as the speaker denies that the business is a scam.
